talking_points: Anthropic's Claude Duet and Meta's Muse show the AI agent wars have moved from chatbots to apps that act on your behalf.
AI models from Google and OpenAI helped uncover a critical flaw in PHP, the code running huge swathes of the web, forcing a scramble to patch servers worldwide.
Barclays is cutting 5,000 jobs as AI reshapes banking, while Anthropic reportedly readies an IPO that could value it near $2 trillion.
